title: standby activity tap options
description: Portable options for the activity probe. Orchestrators can use this schema to build their setup form and the standby tap command.

app_port.description: TCP port exposed by the application.

app_health.description: HTTP health path asked over loopback.

proxy_listen.description: Optional local HTTP reverse-proxy address. When set, the load balancer sends application traffic here and the tap forwards it to app_port. This enables request-aware activity rules without a CDN or external WAF.

ignore_requests.description: Requests forwarded to the app without refreshing the idle clock. Each item maps to one repeatable --ignore-request METHOD:/path/pattern flag.

method.description: HTTP method or * for every method.

path.description: Request path pattern. * matches inside one path segment; ** is refused to avoid accidental application-wide rules.

note.description: Human explanation kept by the orchestrator; it does not affect matching.

ignore_connections_after.description: Legacy TCP-mode option, at least 1m. A continuously-open connection is activity only for this long. Request-aware proxy mode counts the HTTP request or WebSocket handshake once and does not need this timeout.

exit_when_refused.description: Exit after the app port continuously refuses loopback connections so the container can rejoin a replaced app network. null disables it.
